## Want to help deliver the future of space science?

As the only academic research institute in the world to explore every planet in our solar system, our societal impact is measured at truly cosmic scales. At LASP, we are on a mission to transform human understanding of the universe. Each day, our nearly 600 team members pioneer innovative technologies and unique approaches to space science while mentoring the next generation of explorers. We are serious about what we do and are committed to creating a supportive culture where you’re surrounded by people who challenge, boost, and inspire you to reach for the stars.

# Zoltan Sternovsky

# Zoltan

# Sternovsky

## Roles

Tenure Track Faculty

## Biography

Dr. Sternovsky's professional interests include laboratory plasma physics and related experimental measurements, and developing instruments for space. He has been the instrument scientist on two sounding rocket campaigns, and several space missions, including the Lunar Dust EXperiment (LDEX) instrument launched onboard Lunar Atmosphere and Dust Environment Explorer (LADEE) spacecraft, the Surface Dust Analyzer (SUDA) onboard the Europa Clipper flagship mission, and the Interstellar Dust Experiment (IDEX) instrument onboard the Interstellar Mapping and Acceleration Probe (IMAP) mission.
